scores.claim_text: Velo3D operates an 80,000+ sq ft manufacturing facility in Fremont, CA where Sapphire AM systems are assembled.
scores.M_check: EPA FRS query for facility_name='Velo3D' (CA) and facility_name='Velo' city='Fremont' (CA).
scores.interpretation: Velo3D explicitly says manufacturing operations are 'limited to the final assembly and test of the system' with components/sub-assemblies sourced from suppliers. This is light-assembly of a finished machine, not metal-powder-handling production at scale, and the 10-K does not claim emissions-permitted activity. Per EPA FRS scope heuristic, absence is consistent with normal practice for a final-assembly site of integrated machines, even at 80,000 sq ft. Cannot be scored as RED_FLAG without a positive jurisdictional expectation; mark UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: SpaceX is Velo3D's largest customer at 28.4% of FY2022 revenue.
scores.M_check: Tried EDGAR fulltext for 'Velo3D' brand; SpaceX is private (no CIK), so direct counterparty disclosure cannot be tested.
scores.M_value: Velo3D returns 234 EDGAR hits since 2018; top-10 visible filings are all self-filings (CIK 0001825079). SpaceX has no SEC disclosures.
scores.interpretation: Per the named-counterparty recipe, the test only applies when the counterparty is a US-listed filer with a CIK. SpaceX is private and does not file 10-Ks, so neither corroboration nor contradiction is observable in EDGAR. The framework cannot adjudicate this claim from public M-sources; classify as UNVERIFIABLE rather than treating EDGAR silence as a signal.

scores.claim_text: Velo3D owns 58 issued patents (40 US + 18 foreign) plus 22 pending applications across L-PBF / AM / software.
scores.interpretation: USPTO ODP shows 41 granted patents pre-cutoff with at least one match in claimed categories ({'laser_powder_bed_fusion': 2, 'additive_manufacturing': 16, 'support_structures': 0, 'software': 15}). Real portfolio exists.

scores.claim_text: Velo3D has distribution partnerships with Taiyo Nippon Sanso (Japan), Avaco (South Korea), GoEngineer and HarTech Group (US).
scores.M_check: EDGAR fulltext for 'Velo3D' brand across major form types (10-K/Q, 20-F, 40-F).
scores.M_value: 234 total hits since 2018; visible top-10 filings are all self-filings.
scores.interpretation: Three of the four named distributors (GoEngineer, HarTech, Avaco) are private and not US-listed. Taiyo Nippon Sanso is a Japan-listed gas-and-engineering conglomerate (parent Nippon Sanso Holdings) for which Velo3D 3D printer distribution would be financially immaterial; per the foreign-issuer-disclosure heuristic, 0-2 EDGAR mentions of a foreign counterparty/parent is consistent with normal practice. No basis to flag, no basis to confirm. UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: Velo3D operates a European Headquarters at the Augsburg Innovation Park in Augsburg, Germany.
scores.M_value: 2 hits, both Velo3D's own 10-Ks (FY21 and FY22).
scores.interpretation: The Augsburg Innovation Park is a real German tech-park; a 5,000-sqft sales/engineering office is not a class of asset that would normally be cross-referenced in US-listed filings. EPA FRS doesn't apply (foreign and non-industrial). No external M-source corroboration is naturally available for this kind of claim; UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: Velo3D had 294 full-time employees on Dec 31, 2022 (up from 193 in 2021).
scores.M_check: No M-recipe applies — headcount is not directly verifiable via the available registries.
scores.interpretation: Headcount claims are difficult to test against the framework's current registry catalog. No query run.

scores.claim_text: Velo3D ships commercial Sapphire family metal 3D printers (Sapphire since 2018, Sapphire XC since end of 2021, Sapphire XC 1MZ since end of 2022).
scores.M_check: EDGAR fulltext for distinctive product name 'Sapphire XC'.
scores.M_value: 29 hits; top-10 visible filings are all Velo3D's own 8-Ks/10-K.
scores.interpretation: External-validation evidence is thin — the distinctive product name does not surface in non-Velo3D EDGAR filings within the visible top-10. However, Velo3D's largest disclosed customer (SpaceX, 28% of revenue) is private and would never disclose in EDGAR, and 'Sapphire' as a single word is too generic to expect industry-wide hits. Per heuristic 7, treat absence-of-counterparty-mention as UNVERIFIABLE rather than RED_FLAG when the disclosed primary customer base is dominated by a private filer. A more decisive test would require trade-press or import/export records, which are not in the catalog.
